name: Ifa
title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

passives.name: Field Medic's Vision
passives.descriptionRaw: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every 1 Nightsoul point out of the current total in his entire party will grant him 1 {LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>Rescue Essentials</color>{/LINK} point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members.
passives.description: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every 1 Nightsoul point out of the current total in his entire party will grant him 1 **Rescue Essentials** point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members.

passives.name: Mutual Aid Agreement
passives.descriptionRaw: When nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Ifa's Elemental Mastery increases by 80 for 10s.
passives.description: When nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Ifa's Elemental Mastery increases by 80 for 10s.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Focused Emergency Rescue
passives.descriptionRaw:
After his Nightsoul points are exhausted, Ifa will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain his Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Ifa. When the active character is a certain height in the air, the following will occur when switching to Ifa: Ifa will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 32 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.

passives.name: Tactical Warm Compress Bandaging
passives.descriptionRaw: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, when the current active party member or indwelt saurian has less than 40% HP, Ifa will consume 10 Phlogiston and restore 40% of their HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

combatTalents.name: Rite of Dispelling Winds
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and fires off a shot, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

combatTalents.name: Airborne Disease Prevention
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
It's time for the real bash bros to step up! Ifa calls Cacucu in as backup.
After using this skill, Ifa gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the {LINK#N11130003}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul's Blessing</color>{/LINK} state. In the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Ifa will hover with Cacucu's help. When he uses Normal Attacks in this state, he will use different kinds of {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK} depending on whether you Tap or Hold, firing Tonicshots that are capable of healing all party members.

Additionally, Holding the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Airborne Disease Prevention</color> while Ifa is in Nightsoul's Blessing will cause him to use a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Letting go of the skill button will interrupt this Plunging Attack to maintain his hover. If Ifa lands due to this Plunging Attack, his Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.

combatTalents.name: Compound Sedation Field
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
Fires a Therapeutic Sedative at a (temporarily aggressive) opponent. The sedative will explode on impact, creating a restraining wind current that pulls nearby objects and opponents in while dealing Nightsoul-aligned <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>.
When the Therapeutic Sedative hits an opponent affected by <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>/<color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>/<color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>/<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, it will apply a {LINK#N11130004}<color=#FFD780FF>Sedation Mark</color>{/LINK} to them.
combatTalents.description:
Fires a Therapeutic Sedative at a (temporarily aggressive) opponent. The sedative will explode on impact, creating a restraining wind current that pulls nearby objects and opponents in while dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Anemo DMG.
When the Therapeutic Sedative hits an opponent affected by Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will apply a **Sedation Mark** to them.

constellations.name: Vitiferous Elixir's Concoction
constellations.descriptionRaw: When {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent, it will restore 6 Energy for Ifa. One such Energy restoration can be triggered once every 8s.
constellations.description: When **Supporting Fire** hits an opponent, it will restore 6 Energy for Ifa. One such Energy restoration can be triggered once every 8s.

constellations.name: Guiding Spirit of Ballistic Prayer
constellations.descriptionRaw:
When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every Nightsoul point the party has above a total of 60 will grant Ifa 4 additional {LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>Rescue Essentials</color>{/LINK} points.
Additionally, Ifa's Rescue Essentials limit is increased by 50.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent {LINK#P1132101}<color=#FFD780FF>Field Medic's Vision</color>{/LINK}.

constellations.name: Rebuttal in Negotiations With the Night
constellations.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11132}Airborne Disease Prevention{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Airborne Disease Prevention** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Decayed Vessel's Permutation
constellations.descriptionRaw:
The restraining wind current created by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}Compound Sedation Field{/LINK}</color> has its duration extended to 3s.
Additionally, Ifa gains 100 Elemental Mastery for 15s after using his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Compound Sedation Field</color>.

constellations.name: Oath on a Feathered Knot
constellations.descriptionRaw:
When Ifa uses the Hold version of his {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK}, there is a 50% chance that he will fire an additional Tonicshot that deals 120% of Ifa's ATK as Anemo DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
Additionally, when he is not in combat, Ifa will consume 20% less Nightsoul points and Phlogiston in his Nightsoul's Blessing state.
